name: Alice-chan
source:
The official mascot of [url=/p120]Alice Soft[/url]. A polite young girl who often communicates with the player as a medium in some Alice Soft games. She sometimes represent marketing upcoming Alice Soft games in trailers and advertisements.

She is accompanied by her pet black crow named Yukichi.
